explanation: F_k(n) (maxLinesAtLeast) and f_k(n) (maxLinesExactly) are the maximum numbers of determined lines with ≥ k, respectively exactly k, of n points in ℝ², matching erdosproblems.com/669; the counts are bounded, so the sSup is attained. The trivial bound F_k(n) ≤ C(n,2)/C(k,2) for k ≥ 2. The statement matches. Faithful.
